question: How many episodes of the Jujutsu Kaisen anime use "SPECIALZ" as their opening theme?
answer:
**18 episodes.** "SPECIALZ" by King Gnu opens Season 2, episodes 6–23, which is the Shibuya Incident arc (series episodes 30–47).

Source: [Tunefind](https://www.tunefind.com/song/king-gnu/specialz) lists episodes 6–23, and [AnimeCorner](https://animecorner.me/jujutsu-kaisen-season-2-reveals-shibuya-incident-opening-and-ending-videos/) confirms it debuted with the Shibuya Incident arc. Tunefind is the only source for the exact range, and I didn't check it against the official releases.
